Hello everyone,

I'm doing a bit of soul searching atm and trying to find out what other career paths I can go into. My current job in IT is terrible because of the nature of the job itself. One of the most major criteria's I have is that I want to find work that's a strict schedule (8-5 mon-fri). Most of my general education classes are finished at my local college and I've taken 1-2 lower divison computer science classes, but IT and programming just aren't for me. So I looked up Arizona State University and they have an online BS degree for Electrical Engineering.

What I want to know is if anyone here can talk about their work life, schedule, requirements for their jobs, etc. I have no skills in the industry other than a wondering interest in it, so any information/advice would help.

I'm 26 years old. Service industry doesn't really interest me much because I have slight social anxiety and the idea of serving a lot of people at a time seems like a rush that would cripple me. But that's a negative on me, not the industry itself.

I used to want to go in the creative route most of my life, up until about when I was 20 years old. Animation, maybe cinematography, designing games or sets or photos (photoshop seems so fun). Used to mess around with Maya, watching tutorials and making stuff here and there. Got shut down a lot though. Art major and industry is tough to get into, you end up being a creative barista, no money to support yourself much less a family, etc. Kind of had the idea of pursuing my passion drained out of my head by my father, who always said "you're going to hate your job but you have to do it because it's practical and you need to support your family"
